title: Product Enablement Specialist
description:
**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

Teikametrics is revolutionizing retail through our patented Artificial Retail Intelligence platform. Our proprietary orchestration layer functions as prompt intelligence, verticalizing AI for Amazon, Walmart, TikTok, and emerging marketplace use cases. For more information, visit www.teikametrics.com.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Teikametrics is looking for a Product Enablement Specialist to help customers adopt ARI Catalog, our AI listing content product for Amazon and Walmart. This is a customer-facing role on the Product team, where you will join customer calls to help brands and agencies understand the product, get their content generated, reviewed, submitted and published, and drive adoption across your accounts.

You will own enablement for a set of brand and agency accounts, taking each one from setup to published content in ARI Catalog. You will also be the go-to product expert for our sales, marketing and account management teams. Along the way, you will turn what you learn from customers into product improvements and enablement content.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* 3–5 years of experience in ecommerce operations, catalog or listing management, product operations, or customer onboarding at a SaaS or marketplace company.
* Hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central and/or Vendor Central listings, including titles, bullets, item highlights, backend keywords, variation families and common submission errors; Walmart Seller Center experience preferred.
* A strong point of view on listing content strategy for Amazon and Walmart: how titles, bullets, descriptions and keywords drive search visibility and conversion, and how to advise brands on what good content looks like.
* Strong knowledge of marketplace rules, compliance guidelines for Amazon and Walmart.
* Excellent written English and a sharp editorial eye, with the ability to tell when content/copy is accurate, on brand and not keyword stuffed.
* Strong spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets or Excel)
* Experience with Looker or similar BI tools preferred.
* Highly organized, with the ability to run 15+ or more accounts in parallel and always know the next step and owner for each.
* Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) day to day
* Confident on customer calls, able to lead a product walkthrough, explain technical details simply and handle questions live with brands, agencies and internal teams; exposure to agencies managing multiple brand accounts preferred.
* Experience writing help center articles, training material or customer-facing templates is a plus.

  
**HOW YOU'LL SPEND YOUR TIME**

* Lead customer calls to walk brands and agencies through ARI Catalog and get their content live.
* Advise brands on their Amazon and Walmart content strategy, recommending what to prioritize and how to improve their listings, not just running the tool.
* Set up each account's brand voice, required terms and rules in ARI Catalog, then use it to generate content for their products.
* Review generated content for accuracy and quality so it's ready for customer approval and submits cleanly.
* Own the path to publishing for each customer: get their approval, submit content to Amazon and Walmart, then track the results and fix any errors that come back.
* Collaborate with Amazon and Walmart partner teams and channels to troubleshoot complex issues, escalate submission blocks, and manage platform updates.
* Own tracking for every account, including rollout status, next steps, and submission and publish metrics, and report on them weekly.
* Be the go-to product expert for sales, marketing and account management.
* Share customer feedback with Product and help create help articles, templates and playbooks.

**WE'VE GOT YOU COVERED**

* Every Teikametrics employee is eligible for company equity
* Remote Work Flexibility - Work from home or from our offices, with flexible remote options
* Broadband reimbursement
* Group Medical Insurance – Coverage of INR 7,50,000 per annum for a family
* Crèche benefit

**Press Reference about Teika**

Teikametrics' Marketplace Optimization Platform, Announces Artificial Retail Intelligence (ARI): An AI-Powered Tool Designed to Drive Cross-Marketplace Success

*The job description is representative of typical duties and responsibilities for the position and is not all-inclusive. Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned in accordance with business needs. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. A background check will be conducted after a conditional offer of employment is extended. #LI-Remote*  

**Beware of Recruitment Scams**

Teikametrics will never ask you to communicate via WhatsApp, Telegram, or other messaging apps during our hiring process. We do not request payment, financial information, or purchases of equipment during recruitment. All legitimate job openings are posted on our official careers page at teikametrics.com/careers, and our recruiters will only contact you through LinkedIn or official company email addresses (@teikametrics.com).

If you're unsure about a communication you've received, please contact us directly at careers@teikametrics.com to verify.

title: Data Center CAD Engineer
company: NTT Global Data Centers Americas, Inc.
description:
**Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers**

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

**Your role at a glance**

The position for Data Center CAD Engineer will support NTT Global Data Centers' Solutions Engineering organization by developing technical drawings, layouts, and design documentation for hyperscale and enterprise data center customers. The role will collaborate closely with Solutions Engineering, Sales, Design, and Operations teams to develop space planning, power, cooling, and infrastructure layouts that support customer deployments across NTT's data center portfolio.

**What we are looking for**

Key Roles and Responsibilities: Develop and maintain CAD drawings, floor plans, rack layouts, power layouts, cooling layouts, and infrastructure documentation for hyperscale and enterprise customer deployments.

* Support Solutions Engineers in preparing customer-facing technical drawings and design packages.
* Create and update electrical single-line diagrams, mechanical layouts, and riser diagrams.
* Prepare white-space capacity plans including rack placement, power allocation, and cooling strategies.
* Coordinate with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Operations, and Design teams to ensure technical accuracy of customer solutions.
* Assist with computational fluid dynamics (CFD) modeling activities for thermal analysis and optimization.
* Review customer technical requirements and translate them into deployable infrastructure layouts.
Maintain drawing standards, revision control, and documentation quality.  

  

KNOWLEDGE & ATTRIBUTES

L Proficiency in AutoCAD for technical drafting and infrastructure layout development.

3-6 years of experience in CAD drafting, technical design, data center design, MEP engineering, building services engineering, or related infrastructure environments

Experience preparing electrical single-line diagrams, mechanical layouts, and equipment floor plans.

Strong understanding of data center white-space design principles. Knowledge of rack deployment planning, power distribution, cooling infrastructure, and containment strategies.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and Visio.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional and global team environment.

Preferred Skills

Experience in data center, MEP, mission-critical facilities, or building services design.

§ Experience with Bluebeam Revu.

§ Exposure to CFD tools such as Cadence 6SigmaDCX, TileFlow, or Star-CCM+ is preferred but not required.

§ Knowledge of BIM/Revit.

§ Familiarity with hyperscale customer requirements.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

§ Bachelor’s or Technical degree in CAD Engineering, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Architecture, or related technical discipline.

§ Experience supporting customer-facing engineering, design, or pre-sales activities is preferred.

§ Experience coordinating with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced project environment.

  

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

§ Operate computer, peripherals, and other office equipment.

§ Primarily sitting for extended periods

§ Ability walk and lead technical tours throughout data center.

Work conditions & other requirements

§ Exposure to varying temperatures and loud noises.

§ Exposure to outdoor weather conditions.

§ Travel required 25% of time.

§ Perform work from a remote location with stable internet connection

  

**Who we are**

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - Flow
description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

**About Flow by ServiceNow**

Flow is a product and a new business unit in ServiceNow staffed by a team of 0-1 builders. We’re creating Flow, an AI-native conversational experience for natural language automation and enterprise service management. Flow is built on a new tech stack with new ways of working. We challenge established practices and are defining a new product and GTM playbook for ServiceNow. Flow puts what we build in front of the largest possible audience. You’ll have real ownership of the work, the freedom to move fast, and the resources of a global technology leader behind you. If you have a point of view on building and want to start from the beginning again, we want to talk to you, wherever you are.

Plenty of people can ship an AI prototype this year. Few get to build a product that runs enterprise work at global scale. Join us.

**Job Description**

We are hiring a hands-on Senior Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer who serves as the technical champion for customers, guiding them from their first demo and trial to long-term success with Flow. You will demonstrate the product, answer technical questions, set up and enable Flow, and help customers build automations and integrations through AI-assisted, natural-language development. You will solve problems the product does not yet handle and translate customer needs into clear requirements that help product managers prioritize what to build next. The role combines technical implementation, customer success, and support.

Ready to be the person who turns “we’re stuck” into “we’re live”? We’re looking for a hybrid problem-solver who helps trial customers and enterprise IT teams unlock the full power of Flow. You will own complex customer problems end to end, and your work will shape what Flow does next.

**What You Will Do**

**Technical Solutions**

* Work with customer IT and security teams to configure SSO and integrations with tools such as Okta, Microsoft Teams, Slack, and ServiceNow.
* Build, test, and launch automations with Flow’s natural-language builder, connecting to tools such as Jira, Workday, Zoom, Microsoft 365, and ServiceNow.
* Connect document sources such as SharePoint, Google Drive, Box, Notion, and the ServiceNow knowledge base so the AI returns accurate, sourced answers.
* Solve complex customer requirements outside the standard product, document effective workarounds, and turn customer learnings into clear product requirements that you help refine and shepherd through delivery.
* Build proof-of-concept solutions and workflows for strategic evaluations.

**Customer Success and Adoption**

* Guide new customers through a structured onboarding path, setting up and enabling Flow in a few hours so they can reach a live production deployment in one day.

title: Senior Support Lead
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

This role is focused on resolving technical issues, offering guidance, and maintaining IT resources to provide essential assistance to end-users and ensure smooth operations.

Senior JD Edwards EnterpriseOne CNC Administrator with extensive experience in managing and supporting JD Edwards EnterpriseOne Environments version 9.2. The ideal candidate will also have strong knowledge of cloud infrastructure and experience utilizing modern tools for managing JD Edwards in cloud environments. The Senior CNC Administrator will be responsible for ensuring the successful deployment and maintenance of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, along with system performance optimization, security, and upgrades.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **JD Edwards EnterpriseOne Administration:**
  + Administer, configure, and manage JD Edwards EnterpriseOne (E1) environments, ensuring optimal performance, reliability, and security.
  + Perform day-to-day management of EnterpriseOne instances including deployment, upgrades, troubleshooting, and patch management.
  + Provide expert-level support for CNC configurations, server management, and all JD Edwards-related issues, ensuring high system availability.
  + Coordinate the installation and configuration of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne tools and applications in different environments (Development, Test, Production).
* **Upgrade Management (9.1 to 9.2):**
  + JD Edwards EnterpriseOne upgrade from version 9.1 to 9.2 with the latest upgrade tools and techniques.
* **Cloud Infrastructure Management:**
  + Oversee and manage JD Edwards EnterpriseOne instances hosted on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Oracle Cloud, etc.), ensuring proper scaling, security, and performance.
  + Collaborate with cloud infrastructure teams to deploy and maintain JD Edwards EnterpriseOne in cloud-based environments, leveraging cloud tools and automation to streamline deployment and maintenance.
  + Experience with deploying JD Edwards EnterpriseOne in cloud-native or hybrid cloud environments, including best practices for cloud security, data storage, and backup.
  + Leverage cloud infrastructure to optimize performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
* **Performance Tuning and Troubleshooting:**
  + Monitor and optimize the performance of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne applications and databases.
  + Perform root cause analysis of system performance issues and implement corrective actions to improve system stability and performance.
  + Troubleshoot and resolve issues across JD Edwards CNC components (e.g., batch processing, security, database, and application server issues).
* **System Maintenance and Security:**
  + Maintain system patches and updates for JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, including applying fixes, service packs, and critical patches.
  + Implement and manage JD Edwards EnterpriseOne security configurations, including user roles, security settings, and audit logs.
  + Ensure that all security measures are in place, both for cloud and on-premises installations, in compliance with organizational policies and regulations.
* **Documentation and Knowledge Sharing:**
  + Create and maintain detailed documentation for JD Edwards EnterpriseOne environments, processes, procedures, and upgrade methodologies.
  + Provide training and knowledge transfer to junior administrators and other IT staff, ensuring a high level of technical proficiency within the team.
  + Collaborate with cross-functional teams to establish best practices and ensure that business processes are aligned with JD Edwards capabilities.
* **Collaboration with Stakeholders:**
  + Work closely with business and technical teams to understand system requirements and provide technical expertise on JD Edwards EnterpriseOne.
  + Coordinate with vendors and third-party service providers to resolve system-related issues and ensure smooth operations.
  + Provide proactive guidance to project teams on new functionality, changes, and future upgrades.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
* Minimum of 10+ years of experience in JD Edwards EnterpriseOne CNC administration.
* Strong experience with JD Edwards tools such as **Deployment Workbench**, **Lifecycle Management (LCM)**, **Oracle JD Edwards EnterpriseOne Toolset**, and other related utilities.
* Strong knowledge of **cloud infrastructure** (AWS, Azure, Oracle Cloud) and cloud-based deployment strategies for JD Edwards applications.

* Experience with performance tuning of JD Edwards applications, including memory management, database performance, and batch job optimizations.
* Strong knowledge of **database administration**, including Oracle and SQL Server, and the ability to work with database backups, restores, and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with **Oracle WebLogic**, **WebLogic Clusters**, and **Load Balancers** in relation to JD Edwards.
* Experience with JD Edwards integration tools (e.g., **Orchestrator**, **Business Services**).
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues.
* Familiarity with **Agile** or **DevOps methodologies** is a plus.

**Preferred Skills:**

* JD Edwards EnterpriseOne CNC Certification.
* Experience with **DevOps tools** (e.g., Jenkins, Ansible, Terraform) for automation of JD Edwards deployments.
* Experience with **database replication**, high availability solutions, and disaster recovery planning for JD Edwards systems in the cloud.
* Knowledge of **containerization** and deployment tools such as Docker and Kubernetes in the context of JD Edwards.

JDE - Business Services,JDE - EnterpriseOne Server Manager,JDE CNC Security Administration,Microsoft Azure,Weblogic Application Server,JDE CNC

title: Software Development Manager, Just Walk Out
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Lead a new India-based embedded and firmware engineering team for Just Walk Out's edge devices: the cameras, sensors, RFID, gates and networking hardware in our stores, and the device-side software that connects them to the cloud. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll manage 8-12 engineers, set technical direction across firmware, embedded Linux and embedded Android, and partner closely with the US engineering team that owns this charter today.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Hire, coach and develop a high-judgment team of embedded, firmware and edge software engineers, and build an inclusive, high-ownership culture as the team grows in India
* Own the technical roadmap, delivery and operational excellence for your team's firmware and embedded software, from requirements and architecture through release and field support
* Set engineering standards across the embedded stack: firmware and RTOS/bare-metal code, embedded Linux and Android, drivers and board bring-up, secure boot and OTA updates, and on-device diagnostics
* Own the device-to-cloud boundary with cloud teams: provisioning and identity, connectivity, telemetry and remote management, including the device's AWS IoT / embedded-Linux connectivity stack
* Build the test infrastructure, staged rollouts and telemetry needed to ship firmware safely across a large fleet of deployed devices
* Lead the response to field issues, telling firmware from hardware, connectivity or sensor faults, and drive root cause and lasting fixes
* Drive execution with the US engineering team, product and program management, hardware/ODM partners, and cloud, data and UI/UX teams across time zones

  
A day in the life  
You might start with 1:1s and a design review, helping an engineer reason through an OTA rollback path or a latency budget on a constrained target. Later you agree scope for the next release with product and the US partner team, and re-plan the sprint because a hardware revision changed what's possible. In the afternoon you join your engineers on a field issue affecting a few devices at one store, get them the telemetry and a plan, and keep the fix moving.  
  
About the team  
Just Walk Out builds the technology behind checkout-free shopping: the devices, networking and cloud software that let shoppers walk out without stopping to pay. . This India team will take direct ownership of part of that charter, working closely with the US engineering team, hardware partners and the operations teams who rely on what we ship.  
  
About AWS:  
  
Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  
  
Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of engineering team management experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* 7+ years of software engineering experience, including embedded systems or firmware development
* Experience leading the development of embedded, real-time, or hardware-interfacing systems delivered on physical hardware

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
* Hands-on embedded Linux (including Yocto) and/or embedded Android, with Linux kernel or driver development and low-level debugging
* Sustaining a large fleet of deployed devices: OTA firmware updates, telemetry, and remote diagnostics at scale
* Experience at the device-to-cloud boundary (connectivity, provisioning, fleet management), ideally with AWS IoT / Greengrass and MQTT
* Depth in Android/Linux firmware, secure boot, wireless connectivity, or RFID/sensor devices, plus hardware-in-the-loop testing

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. Industry best practices emphasize endpoint lifecycle management, modern device management, cloud-managed endpoints, automation, and Zero Trust security principles.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIE** S

Tasks may include but are not limited to

Endpoint Strategy & Roadmap

* Own and maintain the global workstation hardware roadmap.
* Define and manage approved standards for laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, peripherals, and mobile computing devices.
* Develop lifecycle and refresh strategies for end-user hardware.
* Recommend future-state endpoint solutions aligned with business, security, and operational requirements.
* Collaborate with Procurement and vendors to evaluate new hardware platforms and technologies.

Technology Evaluation & Innovation

* Research, evaluate, and assess new endpoint technologies, operating systems, management tools, and productivity solutions.
* Conduct proofs of concept (POCs) and pilot programs for emerging technologies.
* Evaluate compatibility, supportability, security risks, and operational impact of new solutions.
* Provide recommendations based on technical, business, security, and user experience considerations.

Hardware & Software Compatibility Testing

* Design, coordinate, and execute testing activities for workstation hardware, operating systems, drivers, applications, and peripherals.
* Validate compatibility between business applications and supported endpoint platforms.
* Develop testing standards, procedures, and acceptance criteria.
* Document findings and support enterprise-wide deployment decisions.

Endpoint Engineering & Administration

* Engineer, deploy, and maintain Windows and macOS workstation environments.
* Manage endpoint configuration standards and images.
* Configure and support endpoint management platforms such as Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, Jamf, and related technologies.
* Develop automation and self-service solutions to improve endpoint management and user experience.
* Create and maintain endpoint configuration, compliance, and security policies.

Patch & Vulnerability Management

* Test, validate, and deploy operating system, driver, firmware, and application updates.
* Assess software patches for potential business impact prior to enterprise deployment.
* Develop deployment schedules and rollout strategies.
* Monitor patch compliance and remediation activities.
* Partner with Cybersecurity teams to address endpoint vulnerabilities and reduce risk exposure.

Security & Compliance

* Support Zero Trust and endpoint security initiatives.
* Ensure workstation configurations comply with organizational security standards and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Security teams to implement endpoint protection, encryption, device compliance, and conditional access controls.
* Participate in security reviews, audits, and compliance assessments.

Operational Support

* Serve as Tier 3 escalation support for complex workstation-related incidents and problems.
* Perform root cause analysis and drive permanent corrective actions.
* Engage vendors and manufacturers to resolve product defects and technical issues.
* Support major incidents impacting endpoint services.

Documentation & Process Improvement

* Develop and maintain technical standards, procedures, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
* Maintain endpoint architecture documentation and hardware standards catalogs.
* Continuously improve workstation deployment, support, and lifecycle processes.
* Identify opportunities for automation and operational efficiency.

Project Participation

* Lead or participate in endpoint modernization initiatives.
* Support workstation-related workstreams for mergers, acquisitions, office openings, and technology refresh projects.
Collaborate with Infrastructure, Cloud, Networking, Cybersecurity, and Service Desk teams to deliver endpoint solutions.  

OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Technology evaluation and decision-making.
* Project and change management.
* Process improvement mindset.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to balance security, usability, and operational requirements.
* Vendor management and stakeholder engagement.
* Documentation and knowledge management.
* Customer-focused approach.
* Ability to work independently in a global environment.
* Success Measures
* The Workstation Engineer will be measured on:
* Endpoint compliance and security posture.
* Hardware roadmap effectiveness and lifecycle management.
* Patch compliance and vulnerability remediation performance.
* Device reliability and user experience metrics.
* Reduction in endpoint-related incidents.
* Successful delivery of endpoint modernization initiatives.
* Automation and operational efficiency improvements.
Quality of documentation and technical standards.  

REQUIREMENTS:
  
Education

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

Experience

* 5+ years of experience in endpoint engineering, workstation engineering, desktop engineering, or end-user computing.
* Experience managing enterprise-scale Windows workstation environments.
* Experience with endpoint lifecycle management and hardware standardization.
* Experience testing and validating hardware and software compatibility.
* Experience managing software deployment and patch management processes.

Technical Skills

* Windows 10/11 administration and engineering.
* Microsoft Intune and Endpoint Manager.
* Windows Autopilot.
* Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD).
* Microsoft 365 platform.
* PowerShell scripting and automation.
* Endpoint security technologies.
* Software packaging and deployment.
* Hardware lifecycle and asset management.
* Driver and firmware management.
* Device compliance and configuration management.
* Remote support and endpoint troubleshooting.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience supporting macOS environments.
* Experience with Jamf Pro.
* Experience with Azure Virtual Desktop or other virtual desktop technologies.
* Experience with Tanium or similar endpoint management platforms.
* Experience with Digital Experience Monitoring (DEX/DEM) tools.

* Experience operating within a regulated environment such as healthcare, clinical research, pharmaceutical, or life sciences industries.

Promotion to the next level is not automatic based on years of experience. Personnel are evaluated on proven competency, level of responsibility, and ability to work independently.

title: Socialpilot Template
description:
We are looking for an SEO Manager to own SocialPilot's organic growth across Google and AI answers, and to lead our SEO team while doing hands-on work alongside it. Search is being rebuilt by AI answers.

The role has two jobs. First, brand discovery. Grow how many new people discover SocialPilot every month, on Google, in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Google's AI answers, on Reddit and YouTube, and in the lists and review sites buyers trust. Second, revenue. Turn that discovery into sign-ups, paying customers, and revenue. You are measured on both, not on traffic or rankings alone.

You report to the Head of Marketing on a weekly cadence. B2B SaaS experience is a must. You will do well here if you are revenue-oriented, AI-focused, and like to move fast.

##### **What you will do:**

Grow brand discovery

* Measure brand discovery - Track how many new people discover SocialPilot each month, and where they find us, across Google, AI answers, Reddit, YouTube, lists, and review sites. Grow that number every month.

* Set the organic strategy - Sort our searches by what the searcher wants, and put the team's effort where buyers search, not only where volume is. Build the topical map and decide where we play and in what order, across comparison, alternatives and "best tools" pages, product and feature pages, content, and international. Decide which pages to build, fix, merge, or retire.

* Win in AI answers (GEO and AEO) - Grow how often ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and AI Overviews and AI Mode name, cite, and recommend SocialPilot, and how often they name us against our competitors.

* Run outreach and collaborations. Get SocialPilot onto the "best tools" lists, review roundups, publications, Reddit threads, and YouTube videos that rank on Google and that AI answers cite. Set Reddit and YouTube targets with the teams that produce for them. Build lasting relationships with publishers, partners and creators, and earn links and mentions through digital PR.

* Manage our listings and review sites. Own how SocialPilot appears on G2, Capterra, and other review sites, software directories, and AI app directories. Grow reviews and keep how we describe SocialPilot consistent everywhere, so Google and AI assistants understand what we are.

* Get the right content published. Work with the content team to plan, brief, and publish the content organic growth needs, on time. Review the search side, so every page answers a real buyer question well enough for Google and AI answers to use it.

##### **Turn discovery into revenue:**

* Grow revenue from organic. Own new sign-ups, paying customers, and revenue from organic search and AI answers, and keep growing them. Build the monthly forecast for discovery and revenue, and hit it.

* Put buyer pages first. Win back the searches where buyers compare tools, and make sure those pages lead to a trial.

* Diagnose and measure. Use Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, AI visibility tools and log data to find what moved and why. Check rankings live, by country and device, before reporting them. Tie every channel, including AI answers, to the sign-ups and revenue it brings, and turn data into decisions.

* Bring new ideas and test them. Do not wait for a brief. Bring your own ideas for more discovery and revenue every month, from what the best SaaS teams, our competitors, and new AI search features are doing. Size each one, and test the best with the cheapest test, a clear hypothesis, and a kill rule set before the data comes in. Stay ahead of Google updates and changes in AI search, and act on them.

##### **Lead and run organic:**

* Lead the SEO team. Lead the SEO team and do hands-on work alongside them. Set clear weekly targets, review work, coach, and hire. Manage SEO tools and agencies within budget.

* Run technical SEO and guard every release. Own the SEO backlog with our web developers. Crawling, indexing, site architecture, structured data, page speed, migrations, and redirects. No page is removed, redirected, or moved without an SEO check, and every site change goes in a release log, so we always know what changed and when.

* Use AI and automation. Build AI workflows and agents with the team to research, brief, audit, and report faster.

* Work across teams. Partner with content, web, design, product, and paid to ship pages and fixes on time. Set the brief, hold the quality bar, and keep work moving.

##### **Must have skills:**

* 3+ years managing an SEO team with direct reports, while still doing the work yourself. You have set their targets, reviewed their work, grown them, and hired. Informal mentoring does not count.

* Proven revenue impact from SEO. You have grown revenue through organic search and can show the sign-ups, paying customers, or revenue your work brought. You measure SEO by how many new people discover the brand and the revenue that discovery brings, not by traffic or rankings alone. You know which searches bring buyers and which bring readers. You have built an organic forecast and owned a quarterly number. You can walk us through a drop you diagnosed and recovered, or growth you built, and what it was worth.

* 8+ years of hands-on SEO B2B SaaS experience.

* A deep, current understanding of how search is changing across SEO, GEO, and how LLMs find, choose, and cite their sources. You keep up every week and can show what you changed in your own work because of it.

* Reddit and YouTube experience, such as growing a brand's presence in Reddit threads or in YouTube search.

* Hands-on with AI visibility tools such as BrightEdge and Profound. You know what they measure well and what they miss.

* Outreach and listings experience. You have gotten a brand onto third-party lists and roundups, run digital PR and link outreach, built partner and creator collaborations, and managed product listings on review sites and software directories such as G2 and Capterra.

* AI focused. You use AI tools every day, and you have built AI workflows or agents that made your team faster. You can show us one.

* You bring your own ideas. You spot what others miss, size it and test it without being asked, and can show us two or three ideas that came from you, not from a brief, and what they brought.

* Deep across technical, content, and off-page SEO, with experience on comparison and alternatives pages in a competitive category.

* Fluent in Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, and Screaming Frog, and comfortable with APIs, large exports, Sheets, or SQL.

* Visible and reachable in a remote team. You share progress and blockers without being asked.

Good to have

* Product-led growth (PLG) or free trial SaaS experience.

* Experience in social media, marketing, or martech software.

##### **About us**

SocialPilot is a leading B2B SaaS social media management platform that helps businesses, marketing agencies, and teams manage, schedule, publish, and analyze their social media content efficiently. With thousands of businesses and agencies using the platform, SocialPilot enables teams to streamline their social media workflows, improve productivity, and drive better results from their social media efforts.
  
  
SocialPilot is now part of group.one

group.one is a leading European provider of online presence, cloud hosting, and digital marketing services. Over 2 million customers trust us with their online success. Our global team consists of 1500+ employees operating from nearly 20 locations across 15 countries, with our headquarters in Sweden. Thanks to the support of our partners Cinven and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan, we are steadily expanding the group's service portfolio and geographical footprint.

When you join group.one, you become a part of a global network that values collaboration, growth, and excellence. Join us in creating online success stories!

**We are committed to an inclusive and safe environment, free from discrimination and harassment.**

**We welcome talent in all its diversity. Your gender, background, age, beliefs, or personal story do not define your opportunities here - what matters to us is mutual respect, personal appreciation, and creating a workplace where motivation and collaboration thrive. We believe in supporting your personal and professional growth, recognising you as both an individual and a valued team member.**

**We want to continue to grow with you and why we look forward to getting to know you.**

title: Zabbix Subject Matter Expert
description:
Job Title: Senior Zabbix Engineer / Zabbix Subject Matter Expert (SME)

Experience: 5+ Years

Work Mode: Remote

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Company Overview

Nuventure Connect is an ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 certified technology services company that leverages deep technology expertise to solve complex business problems and empower clients worldwide. Our commitment to state-of-the-art solutions spans the entire product value chain, delivering next-generation software, end-to-end IoT solutions, cloud infrastructure management, and managed IT support services.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly experienced Zabbix SME to assess, upgrade, optimize and consolidate two large-scale production Zabbix environments (v4 and v7) into a single Zabbix v7.4 deployment.

The environment includes 10,000+ active monitoring configurations and approximately 150 templates, requiring strong enterprise monitoring expertise, migration experience and disciplined change management.

Key Responsibilities

* Assess existing Zabbix architecture, performance, scalability and configuration.
* Plan and execute Zabbix v4/v7 to v7.4 upgrades, including testing, rollback and change management.
* Design and implement consolidation of two Zabbix environments into one unified deployment.
* Review and optimize approximately 150 Zabbix templates to improve monitoring effectiveness and reduce alert noise.
* Optimize triggers, thresholds, alerts, actions, escalations and notifications.
* Configure history, trends, retention policies and database performance.
* Improve monitoring of servers, networks, data centers, power, temperature and environmental systems.
* Conduct monitoring gap analysis and recommend improvements based on industry best practices.
* Implement automation using Zabbix APIs, scripts and integrations.
* Prepare technical documentation, migration plans and operational runbooks.

Required Skills

* Extensive hands-on experience with enterprise-scale Zabbix administration and architecture.
* Strong experience with Zabbix upgrades, migrations and environment consolidation.
* Expertise in Zabbix Server, Proxy, Agent, templates, triggers, discovery, actions and alerting.
* Experience managing large production monitoring environments (10,000+ monitoring configurations or equivalent scale).
* Strong knowledge of Linux administration and troubleshooting.
* Experience with MySQL/MariaDB or PostgreSQL database optimization, including history and retention management.
* Experience with SNMP, IPMI, agent-based monitoring and network/device telemetry.
* Ability to develop and optimize Zabbix templates, custom checks and automation.
* Strong Python/Bash scripting and Zabbix API integration skills.
* Experience with high availability, performance tuning, backup, rollback and change management.
* Strong troubleshooting, technical documentation and stakeholder communication skills.

Good to Have

* Experience managing multi-tenant Zabbix environments in an MSP.
* Experience upgrading older Zabbix v4 environments to newer major versions.
* Zabbix HA, proxy architecture and distributed monitoring.
* Monitoring of data center power, cooling and environmental infrastructure.
* Experience with Grafana, Prometheus or other monitoring platforms.
* Ansible or infrastructure automation experience.
* Zabbix Certified Specialist, Professional or Expert certifications.
* Experience with production-critical infrastructure and large-scale monitoring transformations.

Core Skill Focus

Zabbix Architecture + Upgrades & Migration + Environment Consolidation + Template Optimization + Database Performance + Monitoring Automation + Enterprise-Scale Operations

What We Value

A hands-on Zabbix expert, not just a monitoring administrator, who can independently assess complex environments, design migration strategies, execute production upgrades and deliver a reliable, optimized monitoring platform.

title: R&D Engineering, Principal Engineer
description:
**Date posted** 11/03/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19515****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **11/03/2026**

* Principal Timing Signoff Engineer
* Principal Static Timing Analysis Engineer
* Principal Standard Cell Library Timing Engineer
* Principal STA Methodology Engineer
* Principal Library Signoff Architect
* ### **We Are**
* Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
* ### **You Are**
* You have spent the better part of two decades chasing timing closure, and somewhere along the way you stopped thinking of signoff as a gate and started thinking of it as a prediction problem. You know that the difference between a library that works in a lab and one that ships in a million AI chips comes down to how well you modeled variation six months before tape-out. You have debugged enough customer escalations to recognize the smell of a characterization corner case, a parasitic extraction mismatch, or a setup check that looked fine until someone dropped VDD by 50 millivolts.
* You do not wait for perfect data. You work with what the foundry gave you, what the characterization team extracted, and what the customer is seeing in their design, and you triangulate toward truth. You have built signoff flows that other engineers actually use, not because you mandated them, but because they solve real problems. You can sit in a room with a characterization engineer, a customer's STA lead, and a foundry PDK owner and walk out with a plan that everyone believes in.
* At Synopsys, you will work on standard cell libraries that power some of the most advanced semiconductor designs in production today. The problems are hard, the nodes are bleeding-edge, and the work you do will directly affect whether a chip meets its performance target or not.
* ### **What You'll Be Doing**
* + Own timing signoff methodology for standard cell libraries across TSMC N3, N2, N5, N7, and derivative nodes, defining setup, hold, recovery, removal, pulse-width, and noise margins that hold up in silicon
  + Develop and validate multi-corner, multi-mode signoff flows for low-VDD, high-performance, and AI/compute SoCs, accounting for AOCV, POCV, SOCV, aging effects, and dynamic voltage drop
  + Drive correlation analysis between Liberty models, PrimeTime STA results, HSPICE simulations, and silicon measurements to improve timing prediction accuracy and close signoff gaps
  + Debug critical customer-reported timing issues, root-cause discrepancies between characterization, signoff, and deployment, and define corrective actions that prevent recurrence
  + Build automation infrastructure in Python and Tcl to scale signoff validation, quality checks, and methodology deployment across multiple library releases
  + Collaborate with characterization, CAD, modeling, EDA vendors, and foundry partners to influence signoff methodology direction and resolve advanced-node timing challenges
  + Create technical documentation, best-practice guidelines, and deployment recommendations that internal teams and external customers rely on for signoff success
* ### **The Impact You Will Have**
* + Your signoff methodologies will define how Synopsys standard cell libraries are validated and deployed across dozens of customer tape-outs on the most advanced nodes in production
  + You will directly improve the accuracy of timing models that determine whether high-performance AI and compute chips meet their frequency, power, and yield targets
  + Your correlation work will close the gap between what we predict in Liberty and what customers measure in silicon, reducing over-design margin and enabling better PPA
  + You will resolve customer escalations that are blocking tape-out schedules, turning critical timing failures into understood, fixable methodology gaps
  + Your automation and QA infrastructure will scale signoff validation across multiple nodes, reducing characterization cycle time and catching issues before libraries ship

### **Alternate Job Titles** * Physical Design Manager * ASIC PD Lead * Physical Implementation Manager * Backend Design Manager * Physical Design Engineering Manager

### **We Are**

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**

You have spent years in the trenches of ASIC physical design, and you know that tape out success is not about heroics at the end, it is about the flow you set up, the checks you automate, and the decisions you make when the schedule says one thing and the timing report says another. You have managed teams through multiple silicon cycles and learned that the best managers do not just delegate tasks, they clear blockers, teach judgment, and know when to dive into a floorplan yourself because it is faster than explaining it three times.

You think in terms of flows, not just milestones. Setting up a robust RTL-to-GDSII methodology for a testchip team means anticipating where the pain will come from, whether that is a tricky timing path, a foundry DRC that changed mid-project, or a handoff that breaks because someone assumed too much. You are comfortable sitting with front-end designers to understand intent and then translating that into a physical implementation strategy that actually closes.

Managing people energizes you. You hire well, you grow engineers into leads, and you know the difference between mentoring someone through a tough closure and doing it for them. At Synopsys, you will lead a team building testchips that prove out next-generation embedded memory IP, and what you deliver will directly enable customer products.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead a team of physical design engineers responsible for building and maintaining the complete PD flow and methodology for the Testchip team, from RTL handoff through GDSII delivery
* Drive end-to-end execution of multiple testchip projects, managing timing closure, power optimization, and physical verification using tools like ICC2, Fusion Compiler, PrimeTime, and Calibre
* Set up and continuously improve design automation flows across physical design stages, including scripting for repeatability, quality checks, and faster closure cycles
* Collaborate with front-end design, silicon validation, and software teams to align on design intent, verify handoffs, and troubleshoot issues that span multiple domains
* Manage project schedules, resource allocation, and risk mitigation to hit tape out dates while maintaining quality and design robustness
* Serve as the technical point of contact for foundry interactions, translating foundry requirements into actionable design constraints and managing DRC/LVS closure
* Mentor engineers on timing analysis, floorplanning, place and route strategies, and verification best practices, building depth and judgment across the team

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Deliver high-quality, high-performance testchips that validate Synopsys embedded memory IP and enable faster customer adoption of next-generation products
* Accelerate time-to-market for Synopsys customers by ensuring robust, repeatable tape outs that meet performance, power, and area targets
* Strengthen Synopsys technical reputation through successful project delivery, post-silicon support, and proactive customer engagement
* Drive measurable improvements in physical design methodology, reducing closure time, improving PPA, and increasing automation across the testchip flow
* Grow engineering talent within the organization by mentoring engineers into technical leads and building a culture of ownership and continuous learning
* Influence future product direction by feeding silicon learnings back into IP development and strategic planning discussions
* Build stronger foundry partnerships through technical collaboration, early engagement on process nodes, and clear communication during bring-up and debug

### **What You'll Need**

* 8 to 14 years of hands-on experience in ASIC physical design, with at least 2 years leading teams or managing projects
* Proven track record of multiple successful tape outs, ideally across different process nodes or design complexities
* Deep expertise in physical design implementation, timing closure, power optimization, and physical verification using industry-standard EDA tools like Fusion Compiler, ICC2, PrimeTime, Tempus, Calibre, or equivalent
* Strong understanding of the complete chip design flow from RTL to GDSII, including handoff points, verification stages, and common failure modes
* Experience setting up design automation flows, scripting for physical design tasks, and improving methodology for timing closure and verification
* Experience in front-end design or RTL methodologies is a significant plus and will help you bridge design intent with physical implementation
* Demonstrated ability to manage people, projects, and cross-functional collaboration in a technical environment with competing priorities

### **Who You Are**

* You lead by teaching, not just assigning. When an engineer is stuck on a timing path, you sit with them, walk through the analysis, and make sure they understand why the fix works, not just what to change
* You communicate complex tradeoffs clearly. Whether it is explaining a floorplan decision to a front-end designer or a schedule risk to a program manager, you get to the point without losing the technical nuance
* You are detail-oriented but not paralyzed by it. You know when to dig into a Calibre DRC violation yourself and when to trust your team to close it
* You make decisions with incomplete information. Testchip schedules do not wait for perfect data, and you are comfortable making a call, documenting the rationale, and adjusting if new information changes the picture
* You build teams that want to work with you. People stay on your projects because they learn, because you clear obstacles, and because you give credit where it belongs
* You stay current. You know what is changing in physical design tools, foundry processes, and industry best practices, and you bring that knowledge back to improve how your team works

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

  
  

You Are

You have spent years in the space where hardware meets safety, and you know that a chip destined for an automotive system is not just about performance or power, it is about proving that when something goes wrong, the design catches it before it matters. You think in failure modes, diagnostic coverage, and safety mechanisms, not as compliance checkboxes but as engineering decisions that determine whether a product ships or gets recalled.

You have read ISO 26262 enough times that you can tell when a Technical Safety Concept is missing a dependency or when an FMEA is too shallow to survive an audit. You are comfortable sitting with RTL design architects who are sketching out a new IP block and asking the questions that surface safety gaps early, before RTL is written and before verification plans are locked. You do not wait for someone to hand you a safety requirement, you help shape it based on what the hardware can realistically deliver.

You have done the work. You have written safety analyses, reviewed fault injection results, defined safety mechanisms, and worked through assessor feedback without losing your patience or your clarity. At Synopsys, you will work on IP and SoC products where safety is not an afterthought, and where the rigor you bring will directly shape what our automotive customers can build.

  
  

What You'll Be Doing

* Drive Functional Safety activities across ASIC IP and SoC development lifecycles, from early architecture through verification and release
* Develop and review safety requirements, Technical Safety Concepts, and safety work products in compliance with ISO 26262
* Conduct safety analyses including FMEA, FMEDA, FTA, and Dependent Failure Analysis to identify and mitigate failure modes
* Define, implement, and evaluate safety mechanisms at the IP, subsystem, and SoC level to meet diagnostic coverage and fault detection targets
* Collaborate with Architecture, RTL Design, and Verification teams to integrate safety into design and validation workflows
* Interface with customers, cross-functional teams, and external safety assessors to support audits, reviews, and certification activities
* Document safety analyses, traceability matrices, and compliance evidence for internal reviews and external assessments

The Impact You Will Have

* Enable Synopsys IP and SoC products to meet automotive safety standards and support customer certification timelines
* Reduce late-stage design rework by identifying safety risks early in the architecture and design phases
* Improve diagnostic coverage and fault detection capabilities across safety-critical semiconductor products
* Strengthening customer confidence by delivering well-documented, auditable safety work products that pass assessor scrutiny
* Influence hardware safety architectures that will be deployed in next-generation automotive systems
* Build internal capability by mentoring design and verification engineers on Functional Safety principles and practices
* Contribute to a culture where safety is embedded in engineering decisions, not bolted on at the end

What You'll Need

* Bachelor's or master’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 2-4 years of experience in Functional Safety engineering, with a focus on automotive semiconductors, IP, or SoC development.
* Strong working knowledge of ISO 26262 standards, processes, and compliance requirements across hardware development lifecycles
* Proven experience developing and reviewing safety requirements, Technical Safety Concepts, and related safety work products
* Hands-on experience in FMEA, FMEDA, FTA, and Dependent Failure Analysis methodologies
* Experience defining and evaluating safety mechanisms, diagnostic coverage, and fault mitigation strategies at IP or SoC level
* Understanding of semiconductor product development and verification flows, and the ability to work independently with cross-functional teams, customers, and assessors. Experience with automotive IPs, networking or communication IPs, or safety-critical products is a strong plus
* Knowledge of CyberSecurity (ISO 21434) is a plus
* Knowledge of any protocols such as I3C, AMBA, Ethernet, UFS, UNIPRO is a plus

Who You Are

* You can walk into an architecture review and spot a safety gap that others miss, not because you are looking for problems but because you understand how failures propagate
* You write safety analyses that are clear enough for an assessor to follow and detailed enough to survive a technical challenge from a design lead
* You do not get stuck when requirements are incomplete or when a design decision has not been finalized, you work with what you have and flag what needs to be resolved

* You are organized enough to track safety work products across multiple IP blocks and disciplined enough to maintain traceability without cutting corners
* You push back when a proposed design does not meet safety targets, and you do it in a way that moves the conversation forward instead of shutting it down

description:
**Date posted** 10/28/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19504****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/28/2026**

### **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

  
  

### **You Are**

You have spent over a decade architecting test solutions for chips that power everything from autonomous vehicles to data centers, and you understand that DFT is not an afterthought, it is the difference between a design that ships on time and one that bleeds money in yield loss. You know the nuances of scan compression versus hierarchical DFT, not from a textbook, but from making the call on a 10-billion-gate SoC where the wrong decision costs months.

You are the person design teams call when ATPG coverage is stuck at 97% and manufacturing is demanding 99.5%. You have debugged IJTAG networks that span multiple chiplets, written the Tcl that automated what used to take three engineers a week, and sat in rooms with VPs explaining why their test access strategy needs to change before tapeout. You do not just know the IEEE standards, you have deployed them in production silicon and lived with the consequences.

At Synopsys, you will work on methodologies that define how the world's most complex chips get tested. The problems are hard, the customers are sophisticated, and what you build will matter.

  
  

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Define and drive DFT methodologies for next-generation ASIC and SoC designs across strategic customer programs, translating architecture decisions into deployable best practices
* Lead deployment of advanced test solutions including scan compression, hierarchical DFT, IEEE 1500 wrappers, IJTAG instrumentation networks, and embedded test IP across multi-billion-gate designs
* Architect scalable test access infrastructures using IEEE 1149.1, IEEE 1149.6, IEEE 1687, and IEEE 1500 standards for complex multi-die and chiplet-based systems
* Develop automation frameworks, signoff criteria, and reusable methodology packages using Tcl, Python, and Perl that accelerate adoption across business units
* Serve as technical leader and subject matter expert for Synopsys TestMAX DFT, TestMAX ATPG, diagnosis, and silicon lifecycle solutions in customer engagements and internal escalations
* Collaborate directly with R&D teams to influence TestMAX product roadmap based on real deployment challenges and customer requirements
* Provide technical leadership for strategic customer engagements, methodology reviews, and complex DFT architecture decisions that impact tapeout schedules and silicon success
  

  

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Enable successful deployment of industry-leading DFT methodologies across the world's most advanced semiconductor programs in AI, automotive, and hyperscale computing
* Drive measurable improvements in test coverage, pattern count reduction, and manufacturing yield through methodology standardization and best-practice development
* Influence next-generation TestMAX capabilities by translating customer deployment challenges into product requirements that shape future releases
* Accelerate adoption of standards-based test architectures across strategic accounts, reducing time-to-market and improving silicon reliability
* Improve engineering productivity across multiple programs through automation frameworks and reusable methodology packages that eliminate redundant work
* Establish Synopsys as the trusted technical advisor in DFT and manufacturing test, strengthening customer relationships and competitive positioning
* Contribute to breakthrough technologies powering autonomous vehicles, AI accelerators, and next-generation networking infrastructure
  

  

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
* 10+ years in semiconductor or EDA industry with at least 5 years focused on DFT architecture, ATPG, and manufacturing test methodologies
* Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing DFT solutions for large-scale ASIC and SoC designs, including successful tapeouts
* Hands-on experience with Synopsys TestMAX DFT and TestMAX ATPG solutions in production design environments
* Deep technical knowledge of scan insertion, scan compression, hierarchical DFT, ATPG and diagnosis, stuck-at/transition/path-delay/bridge/cell-aware fault models, and coverage optimization techniques
* Expertise deploying IEEE 1149.1 (JTAG), IEEE 1149.6 (AC JTAG), IEEE 1687 (IJTAG), and IEEE 1500 standards in complex test access architectures
* Experience integrating DFT IP including Codec/embedded compression, OCC, LBIST, TAP controllers, JTAG and IJTAG infrastructure, TDR networks, and IEEE 1500 wrappers
* Strong understanding of RTL-to-GDSII flows and how DFT interacts with synthesis, physical design, timing closure, and signoff
* Proficiency with Tcl, Python, Perl, or Shell scripting for methodology automation and deployment
* Experience defining enterprise-wide DFT standards and signoff methodologies is a strong plus
* Background supporting advanced-node ASICs, multi-billion-gate SoCs, silicon bring-up, diagnosis, or yield improvement is highly valued
* Knowledge of functional safety standards and automotive test requirements is a plus
* Contributions to industry test standards, technical publications, patents, or conference presentations strengthen your candidacy
  

  

### **Who You Are**

* You can walk into a room with a customer's design team, diagnose a coverage gap in their hierarchical DFT strategy, and sketch a solution on the whiteboard that they trust enough to implement before tapeout
* You mentor engineers not by telling them what to do, but by asking the questions that help them see the tradeoff they missed between test time and pattern count
* You are comfortable presenting a methodology roadmap to a VP in two slides and then diving three levels deep with an engineer debugging an IJTAG network the same afternoon
* You push back when a proposed DFT architecture does not align with manufacturing realities, and you do it in a way that builds trust rather than friction
* You treat automation as a first-class deliverable, not an afterthought, because you know the methodology only scales if the Tcl actually works
* You stay current with industry trends, standards evolution, and emerging test challenges because you know that what worked on 7nm will not necessarily work on 3nm
  

  

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will join the Digital Methodology Center of Excellence, a highly visible organization responsible for defining and advancing Synopsys' DFT methodologies, best practices, and customer deployment strategies. Working closely with R&D, product engineering, customer success, and strategic accounts, you will help shape the future of Design-for-Test and drive successful adoption of the industry's most advanced test solutions worldwide.

### **Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: IT Systems Administrator (Cloud, Identity, Endpoint & Security)
description:
**Transform 800,000 hectares of greenhouses into fully-autonomous food production sites**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

At eternal.ag, we're building the future of sustainable food production. Our mission is to convert the world's existing greenhouses into fully automated facilities that can produce fresh food year-round - addressing the critical need to double food production by 2050 while facing severe labor shortages, water scarcity, and climate challenges.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for an IT Systems Administrator to own and improve day-to-day IT operations across cloud services, identity, endpoint devices, and cybersecurity controls. You will manage AWS infrastructure basics, Microsoft 365 services, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) identity and access, Windows PCs, and Ubuntu/Linux laptops. You will also implement and administer Mobile Device Management (MDM) and help establish and enforce practical cybersecurity policies and best practices across the company.  
  
This is a hands-on role requiring strong troubleshooting skills, structured documentation habits, and the ability to balance user support with system reliability and security.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

**IT operations & user support**

* Provide Tier 1–2 support for employees across hardware, OS, identity/login, network access, and SaaS tools.
* Provision, onboard, and offboard users (accounts, groups, device enrollment, licenses, access rights).
* Maintain IT documentation (runbooks, onboarding/offboarding checklists, asset records, system diagrams).
* Manage IT vendors and service providers as needed (ISPs, equipment suppliers, security tools).

**Microsoft 365 administration**

* Administer Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive, and core admin settings.
* Manage licensing and service configuration aligned to business needs and cost control.
* Implement and monitor baseline security controls (e.g., MFA, security defaults/conditional access, mailbox security, secure sharing).
* Support email deliverability, domain/DNS records (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), and collaboration settings.

**Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) / Identity & Access Management**

* Administer Microsoft Entra ID tenant configuration, users/groups, role-based access controls, and identity lifecycle.
* Implement access policies such as MFA, Conditional Access, device compliance requirements, and least-privilege access.
* Manage SSO integrations for SaaS applications and troubleshoot authentication issues.
* Support secure onboarding/offboarding and periodic access reviews.

**Endpoint management: Windows + Ubuntu/Linux**

* Maintain Windows PCs (deployment, patching, troubleshooting, device encryption, local admin controls, endpoint security).
* Maintain Ubuntu/Linux laptops (user access, updates, disk encryption where applicable, security hardening, troubleshooting).
* Standardize device setup using repeatable processes (imaging, configuration scripts, endpoint policies).
* Maintain endpoint inventory (hardware specs, ownership, lifecycle, warranty, status).

**Mobile Device Management (MDM) & device compliance**

* Implement and administer an MDM solution to enforce device security, configuration, and compliance.
* Examples: Microsoft Intune, Jamf, Kandji, or equivalent (choose what fits your environment).
* Define and enforce device baselines (PIN/biometrics, encryption, auto-lock, OS update requirements, remote wipe).
* Manage BYOD vs corporate-owned policies, and align with privacy/responsible monitoring expectations.
* Ensure smooth enrollment and support for iOS/Android and laptops where supported.

**AWS administration (cloud operations & governance)**

* Administer AWS accounts and foundational services used by the company, such as:
* IAM (users/roles/policies), security groups, VPC basics, EC2, S3, RDS (as applicable), CloudWatch/logging.
* Improve AWS security posture (least-privilege IAM, MFA for privileged access, key/secret hygiene).
* Support backups, monitoring/alerting, and incident response procedures for cloud workloads.
* Assist with cost visibility and optimization (tagging, budgets, alerts, rightsizing recommendations).

**Cybersecurity policies & best practices**

* Help define, implement, and maintain company cybersecurity policies and standards, such as:
* Acceptable use, password/MFA, endpoint security, patching, backups, access control, vendor access, secure sharing.
* Implement practical security controls aligned with the company’s risk level: Endpoint protection, encryption, vulnerability management, audit logging, least privilege, secure onboarding/offboarding.
* Run security awareness basics (phishing awareness, secure handling of data, reporting procedures).
* Support security incident response: triage, containment, remediation, post-incident improvements.
* Coordinate with external security vendors (pentest, audits, SOC/SIEM support) if applicable.

**Who You Are**
---------------

#### **Core requirements**

* 3+ years in IT administration / systems administration / IT operations.
* Strong experience administering Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), including MFA and SSO.
* Hands-on experience managing Windows endpoints (deployment, patching, troubleshooting, security controls).
* Hands-on experience supporting Ubuntu/Linux laptops (updates, access, security hardening basics).
* Experience implementing or administering an MDM platform and device compliance policies.
* Familiarity with AWS administration fundamentals (IAM, networking basics, monitoring, security concepts).
* Solid understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals: least privilege, secure configuration, patch management, encryption, phishing, backups, incident response basics.
* Strong troubleshooting ability, ability to communicate clearly with non-technical colleagues, and good documentation habits.

#### **Bonus points if you have**

* Experience with Microsoft security tooling (e.g., Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365) or equivalent.
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001 concepts, SOC 2 readiness, GDPR awareness) as applicable.
* Experience with automation/scripting: PowerShell (Windows/M365), Bash (Linux), Python (optional), and/or Ansible for configuration management.
* Basic networking skills: DHCP/DNS/VPN/Wi‑Fi management, firewall concepts, zero-trust principles.
* Experience with ticketing systems (Jira Service Management, Zendesk, Freshservice, etc.).
* Experience building policies and controls in a startup/SMB environment with pragmatic constraints.

#### **Soft skills & working style**

* You prioritize security and reliability without blocking productivity.
* You can translate technical risk into business impact and propose practical mitigations.
* You’re comfortable owning problems end-to-end and escalating appropriately.
* You can create simple documentation others can follow.
* You handle confidential information responsibly.

#### **Tools & Systems**

* Microsoft 365 Admin Center, Exchange Admin, Entra ID, Intune (or Jamf/Kandji/other MDM)
* AWS Console + IAM + CloudWatch (and IaC tools if applicable)
* Windows 10/11, Ubuntu/Linux
* Endpoint security tooling (Defender/CrowdStrike/SentinelOne, etc.)
* Password manager and/or SSO provider integrations
* Ticketing + asset management system

**Apply Now**
-------------

Ready to help transform 800,000 hectares of greenhouses into fully automated food production sites? If you’re excited to build the IT and security foundation that lets a robotics team ship safely and move fast, we’d love to hear from you.

We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

*eternal.ag* *is building fully automated food production sites that can sustainably produce fresh food year-round. Backed by world-class investors and partnering with leading agricultural companies, we're turning the vision of fully-autonomous greenhouses into reality.*

title: Senior System Administrator

**1. Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Senior System Administrator to manage, secure, maintain, and optimize the organization's IT infrastructure, servers, cloud environments, networks, Microsoft 365 services, and cybersecurity systems.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Windows and Linux server administration, cloud infrastructure, Microsoft 365 administration, email security, network security, backup and disaster recovery, malware and ransomware prevention, monitoring, and incident management.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the availability, performance, confidentiality, and integrity of company systems and data while protecting corporate email accounts and infrastructure from phishing, unauthorized access, malware, ransomware, and other cyber threats.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Server and System Administration**

* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows Server and Linux environments.
* Manage Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, file servers, user accounts, and access permissions.
* Monitor server performance, availability, CPU, memory, disk utilization, and system capacity.
* Perform operating system upgrades, security patching, updates, and routine maintenance.
* Troubleshoot complex server, operating system, software, and infrastructure issues.
* Maintain production and internal IT systems to meet agreed uptime and performance requirements.
* Manage user onboarding, offboarding, access provisioning, and permission revocation.

**B. Cloud and Infrastructure Management**

* Manage cloud infrastructure on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Configure and maintain virtual machines, storage, cloud networking, security groups, IAM, and access policies.
* Manage virtualization platforms such as VMware and Microsoft Hyper-V.
* Monitor cloud resource utilization, availability, performance, and infrastructure costs.

* Monitor security alerts and investigate suspicious processes, malicious scripts, unauthorized software, and abnormal system behavior.
* Implement OS and application hardening, firewall rules, secure configurations, and endpoint security policies.
* Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and coordinate remediation of identified security weaknesses.
* Protect servers, laptops, employee workstations, cloud infrastructure, and corporate networks against unauthorized access and exploitation.
* Monitor and investigate suspicious network traffic, brute-force attempts, unauthorized access, and other indicators of compromise.
* Implement controls to reduce risks associated with malicious attachments, harmful links, compromised credentials, and social engineering.
* Maintain secure backups, including immutable or offline copies where appropriate, to minimize the impact of ransomware.
* Perform root cause analysis after security incidents and implement preventive measures to avoid recurrence.

**E. Network and Access Security**
