title: Service Desk Analyst
description:
### **Description**

**About the Role:**  
  
The Service Desk Analyst is the first point of contact for all global IT and service requests, resolving issues by phone, email, ticket and in person, and escalating what can't be fixed at first line. You should deliver excellent, timely support to users across multiple business areas, so that issues are resolved with minimal business impact and within SLA.  
  
The Global Service Desk Team has 5 analysts. It supports 1500+ users worldwide, 24 hours a day, 5 days a week (moving to 24x7), on a follow-the-sun shift pattern.

  

### **Responsibilities**

**Ticket and incident management**

* Act as first-level contact for users and resolve issues, or convey resolutions, by phone, email, service desk tickets and face to face.

* Maintain control of the Global Service Desk queue: log, prioritise, resolve and reassign tickets as soon as possible after they are raised.

* Take ownership of tickets and see them through to prompt, satisfactory resolution, collaborating with the team as needed.

* Prioritise business-affecting issues and escalate unresolved queries to the right level of support so problems are fixed within SLA.

* Track, route and redirect problems to the correct resources.

* Follow the Global Incident Management guidelines and ensure proper recording, documentation and closure of every ticket.

**User support and onboarding/off boarding**

* Walk users through the problem-solving process, follow up and provide feedback until the issue is resolved.

* Manage user on- and off-boarding in line with the agreed process flow and timescales, including updating user data.

* Set up new equipment globally, handing over to regional support where required.

* Install and configure software on user machines.

* Support multiple business areas, including IT, Application Support, Facilities and Travel.

**Service quality and relationships**

* Deliver efficient customer service that meets and exceeds user expectations.

* Build strong relationships across all business areas and represent the Service Desk positively to internal customers, clients and suppliers.

* Take part in the 24x5 global shift Rota (moving to 24x7) so users in every region are supported during their working hours.

* Produce activity reports and attend regular 1:1s with the department head to cascade priorities.

* Recommend procedure changes and improvements, and keep growing your knowledge of help desk procedures, products and services.

### **Skills and Experience**

**Technical**

* Working knowledge of help desk / ticketing software and remote-control tools

* Windows 10/11 and macOS (OS X) support

* Microsoft 365, including strong core Office skills (Excel in particular)

* Basic SharePoint and OneDrive management

* Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS)

* Advanced troubleshooting and diagnostic skills

**Professional**

* Proficiency in English, with strong written and verbal communication

* Strong client-facing and customer service orientation

* Ability to priorities, multi-task and complete tasks to the end

* Good organizational and relationship-building skills

* Flexibility to work 24-hour shift patterns

title: Vulnerability Management Analyst — Semiconductor IP
description:
**Date posted** 10/11/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19196****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/11/2026**

**Vulnerability Management Analyst - Semiconductor IP**

**We Are:**

At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.

**You Are:**

You are someone who builds trust with product and engineering teams when the topic is risk. You listen first, explain complex findings in clear language, and own your conclusions. You help people understand what a vulnerability means for their work and what they should do next.

You are practical when information is incomplete. You stay focused on timely action, challenge unclear choices in a respectful way, and keep looking for better ways to reduce risk. You care about teamwork, follow-through, and leaving guidance that others can use.

This is a full-time role.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Analyze vulnerabilities affecting semiconductor IP products, firmware, and related interfaces, and determine residual risk with clear assumptions.
* Prioritize findings so product teams can act in a timely way: severity, exploitability, affected assets, and recommended mitigations.
* Work with design, verification, firmware, and product teams to explain vulnerabilities, walk through impact, and agree how the team will mitigate.
* Advise those teams on practical mitigations, compensating controls, and verification or test evidence that shows the risk is reduced.
* Work in semiconductor IP development and associated test flows, using the tools those teams use to design, verify, and test IP, so analysis matches how the product is actually built.
* Build and maintain your own analysis, intake, scoring, and reporting tools, including in Python, when existing tools are not enough. Scripts and tools should be readable and usable by other analysts.
* Track open risk through the cybersecurity lifecycle, from intake through analysis, treatment, verification, and internal release decisions, and keep status current.
* Facilitate working sessions so similar IP classes get consistent analysis, risk language, and mitigation guidance.
* Look for new and practical ways to detect, assess, and mitigate risk, including improved methods, automation, and lessons from prior findings.
* Use agentic workflows (AI agents, structured prompts, and human-in-the-loop review) to speed research and first drafts without handing off ownership of risk conclusions.
* Run the job in Jira, Confluence, Git, and GitLab: track vulnerability and risk work, keep documentation current, and version work products through review.

**The Impact You Will Have:**

* Give product teams vulnerability analysis and risk determinations they can trust and act on without re-deriving the work.
* Reduce time-to-mitigation by explaining findings clearly and agreeing practical next steps with the teams that own the product.
* Leave mitigation and test guidance that design, verification, and firmware teams can execute.
* Keep residual risk visible and current so internal release and treatment decisions are based on evidence, not stale status.
* Improve consistency of vulnerability handling and risk language across similar IP classes.
* Raise the quality of risk reduction over time by bringing new methods, better mitigations, and fit-for-purpose tools into the workflow.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree is welcome, not required.
* Typically 3 or more years in vulnerability management, product cybersecurity, embedded security, or a closely related engineering role. Stronger evidence on vulnerability analysis and risk determination can offset fewer years. Title (Analyst or Senior Analyst) will match demonstrated depth.
* Strong practical experience in vulnerability analysis on real products, not only scanning or training exercises.
* Ability to determine risk: severity, exploitability, affected assets, likelihood, impact, and residual risk after proposed mitigations.
* Ability to explain vulnerabilities and recommended mitigations to engineering teams so they can act in a timelyway.
* Working familiarity with semiconductor IP development and associated testing, including the tools used to design, verify, and test IP. Specific commercial tool names are not required.
* Ability to write and maintain your own tools, including in Python, for analysis, intake, scoring, and reporting when existing tools are not enough. This is not a software-engineering role. Tools should be readable and usable by other analysts.
* Experience working with incomplete information and stating assumptions when the end-system is not fully known.
Experience* ing a cybersecurity lifecycle across planning, design, implementation, verification, and internal release, including tracking open risk to closure.
* Hands-on understanding of embedded systems enough to reason about hardware-rooted and firmware vulnerabilities: SoC or MCU integration, firmware, interfaces, registers, boot and debug, and interconnects.
* Experience delivering analysis inside product-team cadence, including re-prioritizing when new findings or design changes arrive.
* Practical experience using AI agents and agentic workflows to speed research, drafting, and repetitive analysis, while keeping the human as owner of technical conclusions.

* Hands-on use of Jira, Confluence, Git, and GitLab (or an equivalent Git forge) for tickets, documentation, and review.
* Clear written and spoken English; able to lead technical sessions with geographically distributed teams.
* Working knowledge of common vulnerability scoring and handling practice (for example CVSS) is helpful, as is ISO/SAE 21434 or a comparable product-cybersecurity standard, digital design or verification background (including RTL), semiconductor IP product experience, or applied embedded cryptography.

**Who You Are:**

* You build trust with design and product teams and keep working relationships strong when the discussion is about risk.
* You own the technical conclusion. You do not hand off judgment to a scanner, a score, a tool, or the loudest voice in the room.
* You write and speak clearly so engineers can understand a vulnerability and how to mitigate it without you in the room.
* You work well with incomplete information, and you state assumptions instead of hiding them.
* You drive timely action. You keep risk visible until it is treated or accepted with a clear rationale.
* You challenge unclear practices in a respectful way and recommend mitigations teams can actually adopt.
* You keep learning. You look for new and practical ways to assess and reduce risk, not only the methods you already know.
* You are collaborative and non-disruptive with product teams, including when you need them to change course.
* You are structured and detail-oriented, and you keep evidence current as findings and designs change.

**The Team You’ll Be** **A** **Part Of:**

You will join the CySec Vulnerability Management Team that supports Synopsys semiconductor IP products. You work with IP product teams in their delivery cadence. You collaborate with digital, analog, mixed-signal, firmware, and verification engineers, and with cybersecurity architects, to analyze vulnerabilities, determine risk, and agree mitigations through the cybersecurity lifecycle. The team works across regions. Your written work products are used by internal product and engineering teams.

**Rewards and Benefits:**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

description:
Overview:
**Senior Digital Activation Specialist**
========================================

**Location:** India – US Shift **Work Type:** Remote

**About the Role**
------------------


At Hyland, digital excellence is powered by the people behind the platforms. As a **Senior Digital Activation Specialist**, you'll serve as a trusted technical expert and thought leader, driving the execution of complex multi\-channel marketing campaigns across enterprise platforms. You'll establish governance standards, champion process improvements, and mentor the next generation of digital marketers — all while making a measurable impact on how Hyland connects with its audience.

**Your Role Responsibilities? Here's What You'll Do.**
------------------------------------------------------

* Lead execution of complex multi\-channel digital marketing initiatives across enterprise platforms, ensuring accuracy, scalability, and adherence to activation standards and compliance protocols.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex technical issues, platform troubleshooting, and integration\-related concerns, translating platform capabilities into actionable solutions.
* Validate campaign tracking, attribution models, and measurement accuracy while partnering with Analytics and Marketing Operations to ensure data governance and reporting integrity.
* Identify, document, and implement process improvements and automation opportunities that drive consistency, quality, and scalability across digital activation workflows.
* Create and continuously improve platform documentation, operational playbooks, training materials, and standard operating procedures.
* Mentor, coach, and train team members while serving as an innovative thought leader, contributing to departmental growth through knowledge sharing and best\-practice guidance.

**Technology Tools**
--------------------

* Marketo
* ON24
* Storyblok / CMS
* Google Ads
* LinkedIn Campaign Manager
* Meta Ads Manager

**Role Essentials**
-------------------

*These are the skills and experience we need you to bring.*

* **7\+ years of experience** in digital marketing activation, marketing operations, marketing technology, or a related field
* Advanced expertise across **enterprise marketing platforms** including Marketo, ON24, Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and Meta Ads Manager
* Demonstrated ability to **troubleshoot complex technical issues** and understand integrations, APIs, and platform dependencies
* Strong **analytical and data literacy skills** with experience validating campaign tracking, attribution models, and reporting
* Proven **leadership through influence**, mentoring, and cross\-functional collaboration across diverse teams

**What We'd Like to See**
-------------------------

*These are a bonus, but not required.*

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Ability to identify **operational improvements** and drive scalable, repeatable solutions
* Excellent **communication skills** with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non\-technical audiences
* Demonstrated ability to **independently manage multiple complex initiatives** and competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Commitment to **continuous learning** and staying current on emerging marketing technologies and platform enhancements

**About Hyland**
----------------


Hyland is the pioneer of the Content Innovation Cloud™, delivering ubiquitous enterprise intelligence to organizations with solutions that unlock actionable insights and drive automation.


Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, including many of the Fortune 100, Hyland's solutions create the foundation for a connected, agentic enterprise, where teams harness the power of AI to redefine how they operate and engage with those they serve. For additional information on Hyland's platform and services, please visit Hyland.com.


© Hyland. All rights reserved.

**\#HylandLife**
----------------


Since 1991, it has been Hyland's mission to help our employees, customers and partners exceed their potential with our industry\-leading content services platform. Our employees exude a contagious energy and are passionate about what they do – whether it's helping customers succeed, raising up their fellow Hylanders, or engaging in the communities where they live and work.


The \#HylandLife hashtag encompasses our employee\-centric culture. Our employees live our culture day in and day out by bringing their best self to work. Hyland supports them to do just that through career development resources, wellbeing programs and innovation practices. We thrive on diverse viewpoints and new ideas and believe that a positive, inclusive workplace is imperative to sustainable success.


As we've grown to a company of nearly 4,000 strong, we have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our communities. We strongly support employee initiatives and align our giving campaigns and programs to organizations that are important to them.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
-------------------------------


Hyland is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all employees and applicants. Employment decisions are made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable laws and regulations. Information collected during the hiring process is used solely to assess qualifications, verify identity, and comply with legal requirements.

title: ServiceNow ITSM Techno-Functional Consultant
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**


To support the Service Automation team within Siemens Energy's Digital Core, this role is established to backfill capacity and address the increased workload from expanded responsibilities and upcoming strategic Energy Now initiatives. Operating at the Experienced Professional (P2\) level in India, the consultant will ensure operational stability, service excellence, and successful execution across key service areas. To address these business aims, the role focuses on ServiceNow ITSM solution design, platform configuration, and stakeholder collaboration. These core areas ensure alignment between business processes and technical implementations while driving out\-of\-the\-box (OOTB) adoption and minimizing platform customizations.


**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* **ServiceNow Solution Design \& Implementation**
* + Design and deliver scalable, upgrade\-safe solutions across ServiceNow ITSM modules (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge Management) leveraging out\-of\-the\-box (OOTB) capabilities.
	+ Configure core platform architecture, including Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, custom scripting, and third\-party tool integrations (e.g., Snowflake, Jira, Salesforce).
	+ Implement and manage technical integrations using REST, SOAP, MID Server, and Import Sets, ensuring alignment with platform security models and ACLs.
	+ Promote OOTB adoption, minimize unnecessary customizations, and leverage ServiceNow AI capabilities to deliver efficient solutions.
* **Functional Consulting \& Stakeholder Management**
* + Conduct discovery workshops and sessions with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and translate requirements into functional specifications.
	+ Prepare comprehensive design documents and define acceptance criteria to guide technical teams and review final solution designs.
	+ Provide strategic recommendations on ServiceNow best practices, process optimization, and alignment with CMDB, CSDM, and SPM modules.
* **Project Delivery \& Operational Support**
* + Collaborate within Agile/Scrum and SAFe delivery environments to support the execution of strategic EnergyNow projects and initiatives.
	+ Perform acceptance testing, validate solutions against requirements, and coordinate deployment activities with delivery partners to ensure operational stability.

**What You Bring**

* 6 to 8 years of professional experience in ServiceNow ITSM implementation and techno\-functional consulting.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – IT Service Management (CIS\-ITSM).
* ServiceNow ITSM implementation and techno\-functional consulting experience.
* ServiceNow Core Architecture \& Administration.
* Flow Designer \& IntegrationHub Configuration.
* ServiceNow Scripting \& Customization Best Practices.
* Integration Technologies (REST, SOAP, MID Server, Import Sets).
* IT Service Management (ITSM) Process Design.
* Common Service Data Model (CSDM) \& CMDB.
* Requirement Gathering \& Business Systems Analysis.
* Solution Architecture \& Design Documentation.
* Stakeholder Engagement \& Communication.
* Agile/Scrum \& SAFe Methodologies.
* Analytical Problem\-Solving.

**About the Team**


Our Corporate and Global Functions play a critical role in driving Siemens Energy’s strategic initiatives and ensuring operational excellence across departments, business areas, and regions. As part of this team, you will contribute to shaping the global energy transition, partner with internal and external stakeholders, and conduct business responsibly while adhering to legal and regulatory requirements.

**Who is Siemens Energy?**


At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.


Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.


Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo

**Our Commitment to Diversity**


Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

**Rewards / Benefits**

* Employees are eligible for remote working arrangements up to 2 days per week.
* Opportunities to work with a distributed, global team.
* Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects.
* Medical benefits.
* Time off, paid holidays, and parental leave.
* Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens\-Energy platform.


https://jobs.siemens\-energy.com/jobs
